paragraph: River Edge is a single-family town, plain and simple. Forty-one detached homes closed over six months at a median of $950,000, with a sale-to-list ratio of 1.00 and a median of 21 days on market. Nearly half sold above asking. That is competitive but not frenzied. Priced homes move, and the ones that sit are usually asking ahead of the comps. Sales ran from $590,000 to $1,900,000, so the median is your better guide than the range. Month to month, most windows carried four to seven closings, too thin to call a trend, and the medians swing on which homes happened to close. July brought 15 sales at $970,000, the volume peak you would expect in a Bergen County summer. If the usual seasonal arc holds, expect closings to thin through fall. Only two condo or townhouse sales registered here, not enough to read as a market.
